title: Rustic Devonshire Pork in Cider
description: Pork loin braised with onions, apples, sage and cider, then finished in the oven with potatoes and mustard.
ingredients: 500g pork loin steaks, fat trimmed, chopped
6 sage leaves, finely chopped (plus torn leaves to serve)
700g potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Melt butter in a large casserole dish; fry onions 10 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Add pork, sage and apples; stir-fry over high heat 2 minutes.
Pour in cider; bring to boil; add potatoes, mustard and stock. Season; stir; lid on; bake in oven for 45 minutes.
Scatter with torn sage leaves and grind over more pepper to serve.
notes: Slow cooker: pre-fry onions; place in slow cooker with all ingredients except potatoes. Cook high 6–8 hours or low 10–12 hours. Add potato chunks 1 hour before end.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
